corpusWideCollisionSweep.interpretation: The 134/777 exposure count is a structural fact about the raw cad_property data (two R-accounts genuinely do share that situs_address in the source) and is NOT something this fix changes or should change -- it is not a defect in the data. What the fix eliminates is that ANY of those 777 exposed accounts still carries a crosswalk-derived companion row at all: zero do. The collision predicate is satisfied at 0 out of 0 candidate rows, not merely 0 collided groups among a nonzero remaining candidate pool -- the fixed guard excludes the entire exposed population from the crosswalk path, corpus-wide, confirmed directly against production.
